描述_EN: porcelains differ from other ceramics in their impermeability, whiteness after firing and fine texture. the term porcelain is applied to ceramics made from a mixture containing a clay called kaolin and a white stone called petuntse, which was fired at high temperatures. this bowl and stand are examples of ding ware, made in the hebei province of china during the northern song dynasty (960-1127). the aubergine-brown colour of this bowl and its stand is known as ‘purple ding’, and a rare find. ding wares were of the earliest true porcelains made in china, and the world. despite having such a different appearance in colour, they are still characteristic of ding ware in their bright white bodies and burnished glaze. while most ding wares are characterised by their ivory-white tone, a few examples have black, brown and green glazes.
描述_ZN: 瓷器与其他陶瓷的不同之处在于其不渗透性、烧制后的白度和精细的纹理。 瓷器这一术语适用于由一种叫做高岭土的粘土和一种叫做petuntse的白色石头的混合物制成的陶瓷，在高温下烧制。 此碗和支架是北宋时期中国河北制造的鼎器的例子。 此碗及其支架的青褐色被称为 "紫丁"，是一种罕见的发现。 丁器是中国乃至世界上最早的真正的瓷器。 尽管在颜色上有如此不同的外观，但它们在亮白的器身和烧制的釉面上仍然具有鼎器的特征。 虽然大多数的鼎器的特点是象牙白的色调，但也有少数例子有黑色、棕色和绿色的釉面。
